known.title: The plan says Claude Code has no per-dispatch subagent effort, but its documentation gives an invocation-level effort parameter from v2.1.292, so decision 9 and step 13 keep the configured effort where a lower delta effort is possible
known.locator: Research, Evidence: effort per dispatch, Claude Code bullet (line 44); Research, Decisions, decision 9 (line 70); Steps, row 13 hybrid_effort (line 101)
known.summary: Line 44 says that Claude Code sets the effort of a subagent only in its agent file, with no per-dispatch effort, and decision 9 keeps the agent's effort for a plan delta round in Claude Code for this reason. The Claude Code documentation (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents#choose-an-effort-level) says that when Claude runs a non-fork subagent at a specific effort, it can pass an `effort` parameter for that invocation, which overrides the agent's `effort` field; CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL takes precedence over both, and the parameter requires Claude Code v2.1.292 or later. So step 13 writes a contract rule that keeps the configured effort on a runtime that can lower it. The evidence and the dispatch rule must depend on the runtime version, with the invocation parameter where it exists.
